messages:
maria (partnerships): Heads-up: we have the marketplace tile dry-run next Thurs. Datadog PS asked for a short "sanity checklist" for traces and dashboards so the SI can rehearse. Can obs + eng draft?

jordan (observability): Yep. I'll start a checklist. Key goals: 1) ensure consistent service naming across runtime and proxy, 2) sampling deterministic for demo env, 3) trace-context headers pass through our edge.

sam (eng-ml): Current state: runtime emits service.name=redwood-runtime, proxy sometimes rewrites to redwood-proxy. We already have a translator in collector config but it's opt-in. I'll add a config snippet to force service.name precedence.

nick (si): For EdgeScale SI customers we saw broken service.name on air-gapped installs because collector mapping was missing resource attributes. Can you include a small test payload I can run locally?

oliver (datadog): I can validate. Send me an OTLP export (json) + a link to a demo trace recording. Also suggest adding a pipeline rule: if resource.service.name is empty -> copy from resource.attributes['service.instance.id'] (or fallback to env var). That avoids empty-service traces in dashboards.

jordan (observability): Draft checklist (copyable):
```
- verify service.name canonicalization: runtime -> redwood-runtime
- collector mapping: copy resource.service.namespace -> service.namespace if present
- demo env sampling: set sampler.rate = 1.0
- 5xx rule: always keep traces for status >=500
- header passthrough: ensure x-b3/traceparent reaches backend
- pre-capture dashboard snapshots and expect fallback screenshots
```

maria (partnerships): Nice. Add one-liner for on-stage fallback (marketing needs).

anya (marketing): Fallback copy: "If live traces appear sparse, switch to recorded-demo-mode (preloaded dashboards + captured trace bundle). Show 'Live unavailable' banner and continue." Need the exact toggle name to script UI button.

sam (eng-ml): Toggle name: telemetry.demo_mode (boolean). I can add UI label: "Use preloaded demo traces". I'll also push a staging config that forces demo sampling and attach secure link.

telemetry-bot: "Config push to staging: telemetry.demo_mode=true; sampling.rate=1.0; collector.mapping.force=true (ID: cfg-2026-09-14-1)"

nick (si): Uploaded a sample OTLP payload to secure share: https://files.redwood.co/edge/otlp-samples/edge-missing-service.zip Please confirm receipt.

oliver (datadog): Received. Quick findings: payload uses resource.attributes.service.name in some spans and instrumentation.library.name in others. Recommend normalizing at ingest with a pipeline rule: set service.name = first_non_null(resource.service.name, resource.attributes['service.name'], instrumentation.library.name). I'll send a snippet.

jordan (observability): I'll add pipeline snippets to the checklist. Also add a small smoke test for header propagation: run curl via proxy with traceparent header and check backend logs for trace id.

sam (eng-ml): Smoke test command (paste-ready):
```
curl -H "traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01" https://staging.redwood.co/health | jq .
# confirm backend logged trace id 4bf92f35... in /var/log/redwood/traces.log
```

maria (partnerships): Action items: @sam push staging demo config + link to bundle by Tue EOD; @jordan publish final checklist + pipeline snippets; @oliver validate mapping and confirm dashboard snapshots look OK; @anya prepare fallback slides. We'll run SI rehearsal Wed morning. :calendar: 8am PT rehearsal.

anya (marketing): Got it. I'll draft the on-stage copy and update the slide deck.

oliver (datadog): Plan to complete mapping validation Tue AM, will attach notes and a suggested ingest pipeline rule.

jordan (observability): One more note: add a measurement in the console for sampled_trace_rate per-service so we can verify during rehearsal. I'll wire that metric to the demo dashboard.

maria (partnerships): Perfect. Closing this thread once checklists + config links are posted. Thanks everyone. :pray:
